pretreatment: degreased in ultrasonic baths of TCE, acetone and isopropyl alcohol for 10 mm in each. After the removal of the native oxide in a 1 : 10 mixture of HF: ethanol
evidence: Two types of substrate are used: (1) plain GaAs (100) and (2) GaAs (100) covered with a 500 nm thick patterned Si02 film deposited by plasmaCVD. Selective growth on the patterned substrates is observed in the whole temperature range studied.
